name: Kidnapped For A Date
source:
You're kidnapped by an actor you're not even a fan of.

Not to take your money or to hurt you. He just wants one date.

[From [url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/kidnapped-for-a-date]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被一个演员绑架了，你甚至都不是他的粉丝。

他既不图钱，也没打算伤害你。他只想和你约会一次。

［摘自[url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/kidnapped-for-a-date]itch.io[/url]］
